name: New Year’s Eve
title: New Year’s Eve at Kismet
metaDescription: New Year’s Eve at Kismet on Main Street in Vancouver, Washington: five courses from Chef Eric on Thursday, December 31, in two seatings. $135 per guest, plus a 20% service charge and sales tax, paid when you book.
lede: Five courses from Chef Eric for the last night of the year, served in two seatings.

notes.title: Paying
notes.text: $135 per guest, plus a 20% service charge and sales tax, is paid when you book. The full service charge goes to the team serving you, and no further tip is expected. Wine and other drinks are paid at the table.

notes.title: Change of plans
notes.text: Cancel at least 72 hours before your reservation for a full refund. After that we can’t refund, but you can give your table to someone else: email hello@kismetvancouver.com with their name by December 30.

notes.title: Allergies and dietary needs
notes.text: The menu is set, with a choice at dessert. Tell us when you book, and please call ahead about serious allergies. Some changes are possible and some aren’t; we can’t create separate dishes or custom menus.

notes.title: Over the holidays
notes.text: We’re closed Friday, December 25 through Monday, December 28, and Friday, January 1 through Thursday, January 7. We’re back Friday, January 8 at 5 pm.

home.title: Five courses for the last night of the year.
home.text: Two seatings, from 4:30 pm and from 7 pm. $135 per guest, plus a 20% service charge and sales tax, paid when you book.
